retrieval_comparison.corpus: 500 synthetic observations: 15 varied originals and 485 templated distractors.
retrieval_comparison.method: 17 authored questions, three frozen-state repeats per representation, five primary matches and 24000 evidence bytes; 15 answerable cases/20 required passages per repeat.
retrieval_comparison.initial_finding: Source-only found all evidence in 45/45 answerable attempts. Plain RRF found 42/45 and 95% of required passages, losing a same-name identity distinction.
retrieval_comparison.refinement: Reserve the strongest original-source match before RRF; add a regression. Immediate search selects and renders under one policy lock, avoiding redundant selection.
retrieval_comparison.final_finding: Both representations found 60/60 required passages across 45/45 answerable attempts. Source-only used less evidence and was faster in this run.

resolved_findings: Initial lint found long lines; formatting and string splits fixed them.
PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy expression normalization caused source-index drift in two migration checks; aligned the model expression, retaining all drift checks.
Plain memory fusion displaced unextracted original context; the failed comparison is retained separately and the refined method has a regression.
The local documentation helper needed the regular sandbox account, not the elevated Docker account, because Git ownership differs; no global Git configuration changed.
remaining_limits: No live model call, NVIDIA authentication, semantic answer score or S06 all-history answer comparison.
The separately requested combined synthetic-only pilot remains unapproved: maximum 96 requests, 1500000 total tokens including retries, $0 paid. Existing flags/budgets unchanged.
Optional dense retrieval is unrun; no embedder or ANN index was added.
Authored diagnostics and templated distractors do not establish blind/generalization accuracy or complete S11.
Byte budgets are not model-token measurements; timings are small local samples with potentially warm indexes.
Whole-observation retrieval reports budget limits instead of clipping; general long-document chunking remains a future measured refinement.
No complete Correct/Forget, known-duplicate/reimport exclusions, entity resolution or clarification-resolution workflow.
